ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, $ AB=AC=5$, $ BC=6$, find the value of $\cos A$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Construct $AE\perp BC$ at $E$, and construct $BD\perp AC$ at $D$,\\
$\therefore$ $AB=AC=5$, $BC=6$,\\
$\therefore$ $BE=\frac{1}{2}BC=3$,\\
$\therefore$ $AE=\sqrt{AB^{2}-BE^{2}}=4$,\\
$\therefore$ the area of triangle $ABC =\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BD=\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot AE$,\\
$\therefore$ $BD=\frac{BC\cdot AE}{AC}=\frac{6\times 4}{5}=\frac{24}{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $AD=\sqrt{AB^{2}-BD^{2}}=\sqrt{5^{2}-\left(\frac{24}{5}\right)^{2}}=1.4$,\\
$\therefore$ $\cos A=\frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{1.4}{5}=\boxed{\frac{7}{25}}$.
